Item 2 — Example: Determining an Output of an Exponential Growth Function Given a Description

Explanation:

Substituting [MATH: x = 2] into the function [MATH: D] and solve for [MATH: b,] we obtain
[MATH: D(2)|= 400 ⋅ b^{2}; 100|= 400 ⋅ b^{2}; b^{2}|= (100)/(400); b^{2}|= (1)/(4); b|= ± (1)/(2).]

Taking into account that [MATH: b] is positive, we get [MATH: b = \dfrac{1}{2}.]

Finally, we substitute [MATH: b=\dfrac{1}{2}] into the function to calculate [MATH: D(5){:}]
[MATH: D(5)|= 400 ⋅ ((1)/(2))^{5}; = 400 ⋅ (1)/(32); = 12.5]
